headline: Applied all 12 bounded audit-conformance corrections to studies 001 and 002 in place with ZERO verdict-word changes: the only two numbers that reached a printed surface shipped as TRUE values with errata — 002's E2 low-income-half complementarity is clean p=0.0395 (significant, was 0.074 marginal) after a half_label fix, and 001's R-legor pooled attenuation arm was implemented, run, and confirmed non-binding.

tables.title: 001-C1 WP (w13028, regional-FE spec) cross-check of suspect cells

figures.caption: 002-C2: low-income-half legal-fiscal complementarity (standardized slope r, common sample) by era, before (gray squares, n=77, missing-income countries wrongly in the low half) vs after the half_label fix (orange circles, n=71). Fisher 95% CIs. E2 moves from marginal (p=0.074, CI touching zero) to significant (p=0.0395, CI above zero); the Q1 'stable' verdict is unchanged because the slope-difference test runs on the pooled sample.
figures.alt: Point-and-error-bar plot over three eras, gray before vs orange after; E0 overlapping and low, E1 higher, E2 orange CI clearly above zero while the gray E2 CI touches zero

figures.caption: 001-C7: the R-legor pooled attenuation arm is non-binding. Bars show the pooled German+Scandinavian median |standardized beta| for the four (generation x variant) cells against the attenuation threshold (dashed, 0.099 = half the paper-era pooled anchor 0.198, dotted). Only X0-within falls below the threshold (orange), but that cell is 'mixed (split)' so the joint-persists bound never passes and the attenuation clause does not fire; all 16 scorecard verdict words are unchanged.
figures.alt: Bar chart of four cells; three green bars above a dashed threshold line labelled persists, one orange bar just below it labelled mixed (split), atten=True, non-binding

notes: No verdict word changed on any surface (binding rule). The two numbers that reached a printed surface shipped as TRUE values with errata: 002's E2 low-half p (half_label fix) and 001's corrected printed AER anchors (verified against /workspace/inputs/paper.pdf pp.1237-1238).

001-C1: the WP cross-check was filled from the real NBER w13028 (2007) PDF, Tables 1-2 (pp.40-41). The WP tables are the regional-fixed-effects (within-region) spec, so this is star-pattern EVIDENCE, not a cell-for-cell replication of the between-region AER tables; every suspect cell stays pending-deposit (Branch R, deposit behind the human gate). Nothing is adjudicated or upgraded.

Corrective study: edited the two prior studies' files in place (the instruction's deliverable is 'corrected files in place'); full pre-correction backups kept under workspace/backups/. /workspace/eval/replication/, analyze/, verify/, report/ were not touched.
Full old->new ledger for all 12 corrections: results/card_corrections.csv.
